capabilities: List and complete Google Tasks in a sidebar view
Insert undone tasks into the current file and sync their checked state
Log in via OAuth and copy refresh tokens to mobile
extras: Setup is manual: users must create their own Google Cloud project, enable the Tasks API, and configure an OAuth client. Mobile login requires copying a refresh token from a desktop device. README warns to update to at least version 1.5.0 to avoid potential corruption of attachments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or manage tasks stored in an external Google Tasks account from inside the vault.

requires.name: Google Cloud Project with Tasks API and OAuth client

summary: Google Tasks integration that lists, creates, edits, and completes Google Tasks from a sidebar view, commands, and inline task lists.
